meta_description: Dataq Software is a global IT services and consulting partner. We build, run and modernize the ERP, cloud, data, AI and security systems enterprises depend on, in 40+ countries, on patented delivery platforms. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001.

blocks.x: Ambition, engineered. Outcomes, proven. Dataq Software is a global IT services, consulting and business solutions partner. We consult, build and run the technology your business depends on — from ERP and cloud to AI and data — powered by our own patented methods and platforms, with every program measured on a metric your board already tracks.

Dataq Software is a global IT services, consulting and business solutions partner, with a worldwide team of engineers, consultants and domain specialists backed by dedicated delivery centers across three continents. We consult on strategy, build and modernize the systems that run your business, and operate them day to day — always with named owners, signed baselines and evidence your auditors can walk.

Every engagement starts with a baseline your finance team signs. Every quarter ends with a measured delta against that baseline. When a program should stop, we say so in writing. That discipline — not a model architecture — is what most enterprise technology programs are missing, and it is the first thing we install.

What separates us is the intellectual property we bring on day one. Patented method families developed by our research programme arrive pre-configured inside our proprietary platforms, so programs start from a configured baseline and the budget goes to the work that is genuinely yours.
Two ways in: deep expertise and consulting, one delivery system

Deep-tech programs enter through an expertise domain; classic-estate work enters through the consulting practices. Both tracks run the same release gates on the same patented platforms — a fraud program draws on data engineering, agentic automation and cybersecurity at the same time, under one delivery plan.

blocks.x: Most engagements elsewhere start from a blank page and a staffing plan. Ours start from configured intellectual property: the patented method families arrive as platform baselines, teams start near full readiness, and the gates prove the delta against your signed baseline. Commercially it flexes to the deal — license, embed or co-develop, with co-ownership terms available on accelerators built specifically for you.

The method families — graph-native contextual intelligence, quantum-inspired optimization, federated learning with homomorphic encryption, multi-layer decision validation, energy-aware workload orchestration, generative workflow automation, self-evolving enterprise learning loops and multimodal pattern recognition — are in production use inside named platforms. The mapping from method to platform to service is on the patented-intelligence page.
